scope: Actual training-sample preannotation optimization, not final independent test or labor savings. A/B references retained separately.

protocol.scope: Train only. Previously explored data; this is a grouped reserved confirmation batch, not a never-used independent test.
protocol.selection_rule: Eligible on tuning first; rank by mean F1. Lock one choice, then run confirmation once. No bulk proposal writes before confirmation passes.

data_limitations: All200 belong to original train split; previous diagnostic exposure and iterative reuse are disclosed.
Known source groups separated for initial40+40; D-FIRE original-event identity is incomplete.
The additional93 were not used for current parameter selection; some share tuning source groups.

tiny_candidate_validation.scope: All are existing training images; reserve groups/history disclosed. Final test remains untouched. No database changes.
tiny_candidate_validation.adoption_gate: All reserved checks must pass original strict per-class TP/FP criteria. Keep failures even when aggregate scores rise.

auxiliary_yolo.origin: upstream specialist; not self-trained or zero-shot

decision.type: Append-only enhanced candidate release after confirmed aggregate improvement; human review remains required.
decision.important_limit: The stricter exploratory criterion of no per-class regression in every small subset did NOT fully pass. Local thin-smoke regressions are retained and flagged; this is not universal or independent-test optimization success.
decision.selection: f1_priority: Base joint fire/smoke, per-class thresholds0.30/0.35 plus upstream YOLO0.15/0.50, DINO-first fusion IoU0.50

batch.decision: Append experimental candidates after overall P/R/F1 and per-class totals improve on200 and overall reserved93. Strict every-subgroup gate did NOT fully pass; thin-smoke local regressions are retained for human review. No automatic approval or replacement of human labels.

code_hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text normalized to LF newlines; Git CRLF conversion ignored
test_usage: Only train references used for tuning/validation. Bulk stage creates unapproved candidates across the existing split; independent test references are not used to tune and must be confirmed independently.
